map.因为按字节截断时切在了多字节字符中间：UTF-8 下一个汉字占 3 字节，从中间: Because byte-based truncation cuts in the middle of a multi-byte character: under UTF-8 a Chinese char is 3 bytes, and cutting in the middle yields an undecodable byte sequence shown as a question mark or box. The correct approach is to count by character (or grapheme cluster) before truncating; if a byte limit is mandatory (e.g., SMS, database field), fall back at the character boundary.
